_doc: Label fixes applied by scripts/clean_labels.py (the raw logs are never changed). STAIRS_START: the rule is first STAIRS press = top step, second = bottom step. In these four demos the first press came 16.6-24.4 m after the left turn before the stairs, only 1-7 s before the second, while in the two DAgger walks and demos 204001/204400 the stairs start 3.1, 2.6, 5.1, 5.6 m after that turn and take 13-16 s; the bottom-step press agrees in all walks (22-26 m after the turn). So the start is moved to the median, 4.1 m (walker's own K) after the turn: the first time the logged distance reaches it.
